versions.subject: Merge PR #4567 from @netgrain - Adding analytics for CVE-2023-22518
versions.detection:
selection_parent:
    ParentImage|endswith: '/java'
    ParentCommandLine|contains: 'confluence'
selection_child:
    # Only children associated with known campaigns
    Image|endswith:
        - '/bash'
        - '/curl'
        - '/echo'
        - '/wget'
filter_main_ulimit:
    CommandLine|contains: 'ulimit -u'
condition: all of selection_* and not 1 of filter_main_*
versions.spl: ParentImage="*/java" ParentCommandLine="*confluence*" Image IN ("*/bash", "*/curl", "*/echo", "*/wget") NOT CommandLine="*ulimit -u*"
